headline: Saudi Arabia Targets SR550 Billion in Tourist Spending by 2030
summary: Saudi Arabia targets SR550 billion in tourist spending by 2030 with 200,000 additional hotel rooms under construction, after spending rose to SR304 billion in 2025.
why: Saudi Arabia is investing heavily in tourism infrastructure to diversify its economy away from oil under Vision 2030.

impacts.name: Hospitality
impacts.why: Substantial tourism investment targets expand hotel capacity and service revenues.
